judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` field instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and wrong TypeScript interfaces (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`). It completely missed the opt-in configuration requirement (`HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}`), leaving the feature unconditionally enabled. Furthermore, it violated an explicit decision and acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor` instead of returning an `error` frame with the new `UNSUPPORTED` error code. It also allowed `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of restricting to integers 1–200, left a temporary `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository, and failed to update `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`.
